hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && { npx eslint "$f"; npx tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .tsbuildinfo.hook; } 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg ctx "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$ctx}}'; fi ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null

description: Shared team hook: typecheck + lint on every Edit/Write/MultiEdit touching a .ts/.tsx file, surfaced back to Claude as additionalContext so type/lint errors get caught and self-corrected immediately instead of at review time.
